currentParagraphText: Jasper nodded solemnly as he gave Jake a hug. Jake returned it as the two sat there for a few seconds before the Planeswarper pulled back and looked up at him again. “Jasper. Jake. Family!”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “That we are,” Jake smiled, making Jasper clap his paws and give him one more quick hug before the B-grade jumped back to the coffee table and looked at the Seeker.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “You go be a real menace to the multiverse now,” he said semi-jokingly as he turned more serious. “And know that if you ever want anywhere to return to and call home, just seek me out and you’ll find it.”
